name: Batik Canting Tool Rest
summary: An original Malaysian canting tool on a wooden display with an open reservoir, narrow curved bore and original cloth.
description: Original Malaysian batik display with an open copper reservoir, a connected curved hollow tip, an offset wooden handle on a separate padded rest and a small original indigo swatch. Static exhibit, not a wax workflow.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Connected swept manifold copper skin, curved open bore, independent display supports and engraved handle, sculpted cloth and original geometric pattern; Cycles studio still.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Original craft illustration, not an authentic artifact, color or size standard, real process or recipe, wax demonstration or museum/vendor affiliation. Blender +Z up/-Y outward, glTF +Y up/+Z outward.
